summary: Do not AOT-lower arbitrary JavaScript source strings executed in a renderer.

target.notes: Arbitrary runtime JavaScript source evaluation is an eval-equivalent capability and cannot be translated soundly by static AST rules.

caveats: If a future runtime intentionally retains a JavaScript engine, this can become a runtime fallback rule instead.
A separately proven constant script may be analyzed as source code before this rule applies, but never by string substitution.

tests.name: dynamic source
tests.expected_behavior: unsupported for Chromium/V8-free AOT translation because source is only known at runtime

tests.name: constant source requires reparse
tests.expected_behavior: must not be emitted as C# string execution; an optimizer may only handle it by reparsing/analyzing the constant source under a separate rule
